sheets.title: Create passkey, the service turns its first try down — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The passkey is registered either way. The base closed the sheet as if nothing was wrong (it never tried); the branch keeps the card open in its warn wash with the facts Saved / First try / Next, a warn StatusMark in a polite live region whose sentence steers away from a second passkey, and the keyboard on Done.
sheets.before: [role=dialog] 0; focus on body; no assertion sent
sheets.after: [role=dialog] 1; .status-mark--warn 1 in output[aria-live=polite], label 'Passkey added to your account, but your sign-in service turned down its first try. Remove it here rather than adding another.'; Done 75x44 focused

sheets.title: Done — the passkey is still on the account — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: Nothing was rolled back: no DELETE was sent, and the list read after the sheet closed still holds the passkey.

sheets.after: Your account rows 3, Account passkey · Added …; no DELETE /v1/mfa/factors/*
